latestVersion.changelog:
Video Maker Italiano skill 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Instantly convert product photos and voiceovers into 1080p Italian videos with AI.
- Simple chat interface: upload images or clips, describe your video, and receive a downloadable MP4 in under a minute.
- No timeline editing or export settings required; works for professional promos or quick social content.
- Cloud-based rendering with automatic token management (100 free credits for new users).
- Supports custom aspect ratios, text overlays, audio tracks, subtitles, and Italian language output.
- Handles popular formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
